stem: Which timeline describes how plant diversity on the nunataks will change over time?

options.label: A
options.text: Mosses completely cover rock. Small shrubs grow between cracks of rock. Small trees become rooted in the soil.

options.label: B
options.text: Mosses completely cover rock. Small trees become rooted in the soil. Small shrubs grow between cracks of rock.

options.label: C
options.text: Small shrubs grow between cracks of rock. Mosses completely cover rock. Small trees become rooted in the soil.

options.label: D
options.text: Small shrubs grow between cracks of rock. Small trees become rooted in the soil. Mosses completely cover rock.
